title: FAA Starship-Super Heavy at LC-39A Record of Decision
summary: FAA's final environmental decision supports later licensing action for Starship-Super Heavy infrastructure and operations at LC-39A under the selected alternative and mitigation framework.
key_findings: The ROD covers infrastructure, testing, launches, and Starship and booster landings at LC-39A.
The environmental analysis evaluates up to 44 launches and associated landing activity per year.
FAA states that environmental-review completion does not guarantee issuance or modification of a vehicle operator license.
why_it_matters: It closes an environmental-decision stage while leaving the decisive operator-license and operating stages open.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a current named Space Coast authorization record.
Creates a direct path to later license and construction evidence.
Prevents environmental clearance from being presented as mission approval.
evidence_limits: The ROD is not the vehicle operator license.
It does not prove construction, launch availability, safe operation, mission success, or utilization.
